findings.summary: Source-native fidelity was not reproducible because synthetic Sources lacked checked-in artifacts and claim-level locators were opaque tokens.
The refinement temporal envelope could not preserve the open, qualified, inclusive/exclusive and alternative semantics accepted in #330.
The validator did not enforce one unique series per atomic subject and target key or target-key/dimension consistency.
The concrete scenarios correctly distinguished refinement, correction, alternatives, withdrawal, world-state change and unknown route semantics.
Governance routing preserved Gate D and frozen contract/data boundaries and retained the material-decision stop rule.

commands: inspect contract, governance, package, schema and validator
run refinement validator and focused tests
conclusion: Three material semantic gaps prevent READY; the reviewed candidate otherwise preserves the intended Gate D and capability boundaries.
